latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Xiaoming Video skill for fast personal video editing and export.
- Upload raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and request edits by describing your needs.
- Automated connection to the cloud video processing API—handles token setup, session creation, and status feedback.
- Supports actions like trimming, adding subtitles, viewing credits, exporting as 1080p MP4, and more via simple prompts.
- Designed for quick, easy edits for casual creators; no editing experience required.
- Backend handles error cases (file types, credit usage, export restrictions) and guides users accordingly.
